apps.name: Windows app support (Wine + Proton)
apps.description: Run .exe and .msi programs through Wine and Proton — a translation layer, not a copy of Windows. Recommended for everyone.

apps.name: Steam
apps.description: Valve's store and launcher with Proton for Windows games. Multiplayer titles with anti-cheat only work if the developer enabled it for Proton (see protondb.com).

apps.name: Roblox (Sober)
apps.description: Roblox through Sober, a community runtime for the Android client (Flatpak). The Windows Roblox client does not run on Linux.

apps.name: Minecraft (Prism Launcher)
apps.description: Minecraft Java runs natively. Prism Launcher manages instances and mods; you sign in with the Microsoft account that owns the game.

apps.name: Heroic (Epic/GOG)
apps.description: Heroic Games Launcher for Epic Games Store, GOG and Amazon titles, using Proton where needed.

apps.name: Lutris
apps.description: Lutris runs games from Battle.net, EA, Ubisoft and other stores through Wine/Proton install scripts.

apps.name: Bottles
apps.description: Bottles manages Wine prefixes with per-app settings and is used by the Creator recipes (Flatpak).

apps.name: Office (LibreOffice already installed) — add OnlyOffice
apps.description: LibreOffice is already installed. Also add OnlyOffice Desktop Editors for a Microsoft-Office-like layout (Flatpak).

apps.name: Creative (GIMP, Krita, Kdenlive)
apps.description: Native creative apps: GIMP for photos, Krita for painting and Kdenlive for video editing.
